football_evidence.question: Can TCU take away Kansas’ big plays?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 0.1 points.
supporting: When TCU has the ball (big plays on the ground): TCU’s offense turns 3.3% of its runs into explosive gains, and Kansas’ defense gives up explosive gains on 6.8% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.5%).

When TCU has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): TCU’s offense has allowed a sack on 7.7% of its dropbacks, and Kansas’ defense sacks the quarterback on 6.0% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).

When Kansas has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Kansas’ offense is stopped at or behind the line on 12.8% of its runs, and TCU’s defense stops 16.6% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.5%).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Kansas’ offensive line No. 15 nationally and TCU’s No. 77.
contradicting: When Kansas has the ball (big plays on the ground): Kansas’ offense turns 7.0% of its runs into explosive gains, and TCU’s defense gives up explosive gains on 3.5% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.5%).

When Kansas has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Kansas’ offense has allowed a sack on 4.5% of its dropbacks, and TCU’s defense sacks the quarterback on 7.5% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.7%).
When Kansas has the ball (the passing game against the pass defense): Kansas’ offense averages 7.4 yards per pass attempt, and TCU’s defense allows 5.7 yards per pass attempt (FBS average 7.4).

When Kansas has the ball (early downs): Kansas’ offense succeeds on 41.9% of its first- and second-down plays, and TCU’s defense allows success on 33.0% of first- and second-down plays (FBS average 42.6%).
quarterbacks: Jaden Craig has completed 161 of 239 passes (67.4%) for 2,059 yards, 8.6 yards per attempt, 11 touchdowns and 6 interceptions in seven games for TCU, and has been sacked on 20 of 259 dropbacks.

Isaiah Marshall has completed 105 of 196 passes (53.6%) for 1,550 yards, 7.9 yards per attempt, 12 touchdowns and 7 interceptions in seven games for Kansas, and has been sacked on 11 of 207 dropbacks.
